==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* One of the [[An Audience with Master Togo]] quests active.

===Objectives===
* Speak with [[Guardsman Miru]] in [[Sunqua Vale]].
* Travel with Guardsman Miru and the Tengu to clear the roads to Shing Jea Monastery of [[Naga]]. You have [8...0] of 8 Naga groups left.
* See [[Master of Celebrations]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*250 [[Experience]]
*30 [[Naga Fang]]s

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
{{section-stub|Missing accept and decline dialogue}}
'''Master of Celebrations'''
:''"I have some rather sour news to deliver on this day of otherwise joyous celebration. It seems the Naga have slithered forth from their caves to ruin the festivities. We have received word that they were assaulting travellers who are on their way to the monastery to celebrate. They attack Tengu and humans alike in Sunqua Vale. Guardsman Miro has gathered a group of Tengu friends just outside who will put an end to this Naga trouble. Will you help them clear the road of these fiends?"''
